say:3:1223501002:1.text: How come you're all battered and bruised? Are you okay?
say:3:1223501002:1.source_cn: 你怎么浑身是伤，没事吧？

say:4:1223501003:1.text: I'm going to tell Renata that I was beaten up by the Carmine Whispers.
say:4:1223501003:1.source_cn: 我寻思见雷纳塔时候，就说被血薇帮打了。

say:5:1223501004:1.text: Given how paranoid she is, she'll only believe me when she sees my wounds.
say:5:1223501004:1.source_cn: 她性子多疑，看到我身上的伤，才会相信我。

say:6:1223501005:1.text: Still, you look pretty rough. Who did this to you?

say:7:1223501006:1.text: Paz and Thoreau. Maybe they've long been itching to punch me. I don't think they held back, haha!
say:7:1223501006:1.source_cn: 帕斯和梭罗，可能他俩早就想打我了，打的很真哈哈哈！

choice_prompt:8:1223501006.text: Paz and Thoreau. Maybe they've long been itching to punch me. I don't think they held back, haha!
choice_prompt:8:1223501006.source_cn: 帕斯和梭罗，可能他俩早就想打我了，打的很真哈哈哈！

say:11:1223501007:0.text: Looks like they went really hard with their punches...

say:12:1223501008:1.text: Everything's worthwhile as long as I can gain Renata's trust. I've arranged to meet her at Ashen Bay.
say:12:1223501008:1.source_cn: 这不重要，重要的是让雷纳塔相信我，我和她约了在灰烬湾见面。

say:13:1223501009:1.text: We Water Wights have an unspoken rule. Are you aware of it?
say:13:1223501009:1.source_cn: 但……水鬼帮有个不成文的规矩，你们也知道吧？

choice_prompt:14:1223501009.text: We Water Wights have an unspoken rule. Are you aware of it?
choice_prompt:14:1223501009.source_cn: 但……水鬼帮有个不成文的规矩，你们也知道吧？

say:15:1223501010:1.text: That's right! You must have seen how it's done when you raided us at the Lookout Point last time.
say:15:1223501010:1.source_cn: 对对对，你们去瞭望角抄我们家的时候，应该见识过。
say:15:1223501010:1.male: That's right! You must have seen how it's done when you raided us at the Lookout Point last time.
say:15:1223501010:1.female: That's right! You must have seen how it's done when you raided us at the Lookout Point last time.

say:17:1223501014:1.text: What should you offer them? Fish or cash?
say:17:1223501014:1.source_cn: 那要上贡什么东西呢？鱼？还是钱？

say:18:1223501015:1.text: A damedangler, at the very least. I'll get Paz to catch it.
say:18:1223501015:1.source_cn: 最次也要冥湾美人，我准备让帕斯去钓。

say:19:1223501016:1.text: Paz isn't the brightest among us, but he's really good at fishing.
say:19:1223501016:1.source_cn: 帕斯虽然脑子不太好，但钓鱼还是有一手的。

say:22:1223501017:1.text: How about we go with him to make sure everything goes well?
say:22:1223501017:1.source_cn: 为免出意外，我们也跟着去瞧瞧吧？

say:23:1223501018:1.text: Great! With you around, I won't have to worry about Paz.
say:23:1223501018:1.source_cn: 有你们跟着，我就更放心了。

say:25:1223501012:1.text: What are you talking about? I have to pay them tribute! Simply put, it's bribery.
say:25:1223501012:1.source_cn: 什么话，是上贡！说白了就是贿赂。<key:dialog1>
say:25:1223501012:1.male: What are you talking about? I have to pay them tribute! Simply put, it's bribery.
say:25:1223501012:1.female: What are you talking about? I have to pay them tribute! Simply put, it's bribery.

say:26:1223501013:1.text: What are you talking about? I have to pay them tribute! Simply put, it's bribery.
say:26:1223501013:1.source_cn: 什么话，是上贡！说白了就是贿赂。<key:dialog2>
say:26:1223501013:1.male: What are you talking about? I have to pay them tribute! Simply put, it's bribery.
say:26:1223501013:1.female: What are you talking about? I have to pay them tribute! Simply put, it's bribery.

choice:8:0:1.text: Did you just crack a joke?
choice:8:0:1.male: Did you just crack a joke?
choice:8:0:1.female: Did you just crack a joke?

choice:8:1:2.text: We can take over next time.
choice:8:1:2.male: We can take over next time.
choice:8:1:2.female: We can take over next time.

say:0:1223502001:0.text: This spot's good. Let's cast the rod!
say:0:1223502001:0.male: This spot's good. Let's cast the rod!
say:0:1223502001:0.female: This spot's good. Let's cast the rod!

say:1:1223502002:0.text: Let's see who catches a damedangler first!
say:1:1223502002:0.source_cn: 看咱俩谁先钓到冥湾美人！
say:1:1223502002:0.male: Let's see who catches a damedangler first!
say:1:1223502002:0.female: Let's see who catches a damedangler first!

say:0:1223503001:0.text: That's a huge one! You won!
say:0:1223503001:0.source_cn: 可以啊！这么大的冥湾美人，是你赢了！
say:0:1223503001:0.male: That's a huge one! You won!
say:0:1223503001:0.female: That's a huge one! You won!

say:1:1223503002:0.text: It's almost time. You should change into our uniform.
say:1:1223503002:0.source_cn: 时间快到了，你快换水鬼的衣服吧。
say:1:1223503002:0.male: It's almost time. You should change into our uniform.
say:1:1223503002:0.female: It's almost time. You should change into our uniform.

say:0:1223504001:0.text: Let's head to Ashen Bay now.
say:0:1223504001:0.source_cn: 差不多了，我们去灰烬湾吧。
say:0:1223504001:0.male: Let's head to Ashen Bay now.
say:0:1223504001:0.female: Let's head to Ashen Bay now.

say:2:1223505002:1.text: Renata hasn't arrived yet, but she should be here soon.
say:2:1223505002:1.source_cn: 我看过了，雷纳塔还没到，应该快来了。
say:2:1223505002:1.male: Renata hasn't arrived yet, but she should be here soon.
say:2:1223505002:1.female: Renata hasn't arrived yet, but she should be here soon.

say:3:1223505003:1.text: Word is she's been very cautious lately. I wonder if she'll spring any surprises on me later.
say:3:1223505003:1.source_cn: 不过，听说她最近警惕得很，不知道一会又闹出什么乱子。
say:3:1223505003:1.male: Word is she's been very cautious lately. I wonder if she'll spring any surprises on me later.
say:3:1223505003:1.female: Word is she's been very cautious lately. I wonder if she'll spring any surprises on me later.

say:4:1223505004:1.text: You played a big part in wiping out our gang back then.
say:4:1223505004:1.source_cn: 你知道，剿灭水鬼帮的时候你发挥了很大的作用。
say:4:1223505004:1.male: You played a big part in wiping out our gang back then.
say:4:1223505004:1.female: You played a big part in wiping out our gang back then.

say:5:1223505005:1.source_cn: 如果待会她认出你的话……

say:6:1223505006:1.text: *Cough* Let's say she recognizes you, how about we put on a little show for her?
say:6:1223505006:1.source_cn: 咳咳，当然我是说如果啊，如果她认出了你，我们就演一出戏如何？
say:6:1223505006:1.male: *Cough* Let's say she recognizes you, how about we put on a little show for her?
say:6:1223505006:1.female: *Cough* Let's say she recognizes you, how about we put on a little show for her?

choice_prompt:7:1223505006.text: *Cough* Let's say she recognizes you, how about we put on a little show for her?
choice_prompt:7:1223505006.source_cn: 咳咳，当然我是说如果啊，如果她认出了你，我们就演一出戏如何？
choice_prompt:7:1223505006.male: *Cough* Let's say she recognizes you, how about we put on a little show for her?
choice_prompt:7:1223505006.female: *Cough* Let's say she recognizes you, how about we put on a little show for her?

say:8:1223505008:0.text: In short, I'll sell you out and tell Renata you are my captives. Then, I'll offer you to her as a gift.
say:8:1223505008:0.source_cn: 简单来说，我会出卖你们，就说你们是我抓来的俘虏，送给雷...
say:8:1223505008:0.male: In short, I'll sell you out and tell Renata you are my captives. Then, I'll offer you to her as a gift.
say:8:1223505008:0.female: In short, I'll sell you out and tell Renata you are my captives. Then, I'll offer you to her as a gift.

choice_prompt:9:1223505008.text: In short, I'll sell you out and tell Renata you are my captives. Then, I'll offer you to her as a gift.
choice_prompt:9:1223505008.source_cn: 简单来说，我会出卖你们，就说你们是我抓来的俘虏，送给雷纳塔的见面礼。
choice_prompt:9:1223505008.male: In short, I'll sell you out and tell Renata you are my captives. Then, I'll offer you to her as a gift.
choice_prompt:9:1223505008.female: In short, I'll sell you out and tell Renata you are my captives. Then, I'll offer you to her as a gift.

say:10:1223505009:0.text: Exactly! It's to show Renata that we're sincere.
say:10:1223505009:0.source_cn: 对！就是意思一下，让雷纳塔看到我们合作的诚意。
say:10:1223505009:0.male: Exactly! It's to show Renata that we're sincere.
say:10:1223505009:0.female: Exactly! It's to show Renata that we're sincere.

say:11:1223505010:0.text: You must have noticed it at the Lookout Point, right? This is how you win the favor of the Water Wights.
say:11:1223505010:0.source_cn: 你们去瞭望角的时候，应该见识过了？水鬼们就是好这一口。
say:11:1223505010:0.male: You must have noticed it at the Lookout Point, right? This is how you win the favor of the Water Wights.
say:11:1223505010:0.female: You must have noticed it at the Lookout Point, right? This is how you win the favor of the Water Wights.

choice_prompt:12:1223505010.text: You must have noticed it at the Lookout Point, right? This is how you win the favor of the Water Wights.
choice_prompt:12:1223505010.source_cn: 你们去瞭望角的时候，应该见识过了？水鬼们就是好这一口。
choice_prompt:12:1223505010.male: You must have noticed it at the Lookout Point, right? This is how you win the favor of the Water Wights.
choice_prompt:12:1223505010.female: You must have noticed it at the Lookout Point, right? This is how you win the favor of the Water Wights.

say:13:1223505012:0.source_cn: 那就这样说定了，我们过去吧。

say:15:1223505011:0.text: I thought you'd find it a bad idea. Just remember it's an act!
say:15:1223505011:0.source_cn: 我还担心你不愿意，你知道是演戏就可以了。
say:15:1223505011:0.male: I thought you'd find it a bad idea. Just remember it's an act!
say:15:1223505011:0.female: I thought you'd find it a bad idea. Just remember it's an act!

say:0:1223506001:0.text: Eh? Why isn't she here yet?
say:0:1223506001:0.source_cn: 嗯？时间已经到了，她没来？
say:0:1223506001:0.male: Eh? Why isn't she here yet?
say:0:1223506001:0.female: Eh? Why isn't she here yet?

say:0:1223508001:0.text: I think we need to switch to Plan B.
say:0:1223508001:0.source_cn: 看样子，我们要执行另一个计划了。
say:0:1223508001:0.male: I think we need to switch to Plan B.
say:0:1223508001:0.female: I think we need to switch to Plan B.

say:0:1223515001:0.text: What on earth have they eaten...

say:2:1223516001:1.text: This should be the medication guide for the powder!
say:2:1223516001:1.source_cn: 这应该是那包粉末的说明书！

say:3:1223516002:1.text: It's just jolly clam powder... I reckon Viperian uses this to torment his captives! Consuming it will cause itching, but it's non-poisonous.
say:3:1223516002:1.source_cn: 原来是笑口贝粉末……看起来是维珀里安折磨人用的！误食会...

say:4:1223516003:1.text: Magister! How about we turn this into a ruse to fool Renata?
say:4:1223516003:1.source_cn: 梅林！不如我们将计就计，哄骗下雷纳塔如何？
say:4:1223516003:1.male: Magister! How about we turn this into a ruse to fool Renata?
say:4:1223516003:1.female: Magister! How about we turn this into a ruse to fool Renata?

choice_prompt:5:1223516003.text: Magister! How about we turn this into a ruse to fool Renata?
choice_prompt:5:1223516003.source_cn: 梅林！不如我们将计就计，哄骗下雷纳塔如何？
choice_prompt:5:1223516003.male: Magister! How about we turn this into a ruse to fool Renata?
choice_prompt:5:1223516003.female: Magister! How about we turn this into a ruse to fool Renata?

say:2:1223517001:1.text: Don't worry. You will stop feeling the itch soon.
say:2:1223517001:1.source_cn: 放心吧，待会就不会痒了。

say:4:1223517003:1.text: We've confirmed it—this powder is made from snake venom in Viperian's lab, and it's fatal.
say:4:1223517003:1.source_cn: 我们已经确认过了，这是维珀里安实验室的蛇毒，吃了就没救。

say:6:1223517005:0.text: Magister, please! I'll do everything you ask. Please help me!
say:6:1223517005:0.source_cn: ——魔法师！大魔法师！我完了，你要什么我都答应！救救我！
say:6:1223517005:0.male: Magister, please! I'll do everything you ask. Please help me!
say:6:1223517005:0.female: Magister, please! I'll do everything you ask. Please help me!

choice_prompt:7:1223517005.text: Magister, please! I'll do everything you ask. Please help me!
choice_prompt:7:1223517005.source_cn: ——魔法师！大魔法师！我完了，你要什么我都答应！救救我！
choice_prompt:7:1223517005.male: Magister, please! I'll do everything you ask. Please help me!
choice_prompt:7:1223517005.female: Magister, please! I'll do everything you ask. Please help me!

say:8:1223517006:0.text: You have a heart of gold!
say:8:1223517006:0.male: You have a heart of gold!
say:8:1223517006:0.female: You have a heart of gold!

say:9:1223517008:1.text: Actually, there's a way. You know the carmines planted by the Whispers, right? You can brew some petals in water and drink it to neutralize the poison.
say:9:1223517008:1.source_cn: 倒也有办法，血薇帮种植的血薇花瓣知道吧，泡过的水喝一下...

say:10:1223517009:1.text: H-how can I be sure you are speaking the truth?
say:10:1223517009:1.source_cn: 我、我怎么知道你是不是在骗我！

choice_prompt:11:1223517009.text: H-how can I be sure you are speaking the truth?
choice_prompt:11:1223517009.source_cn: 我、我怎么知道你是不是在骗我！

say:12:1223517010:1.text: But... wouldn't I be walking straight into my enemies' trap?
say:12:1223517010:1.source_cn: 但是、但是……让我去找血薇帮要解药，不就等于自投罗网？！

say:13:1223517011:1.text: That's right—you must turn yourself in to stay alive!
say:13:1223517011:1.source_cn: 没错，你必须乖乖认罪！才能保命！

say:18:1223517013:1.text: What does revenge even mean when you're dying?
say:18:1223517013:1.source_cn: 命都没了还谈什么报仇？

say:19:1223517014:1.text: You can give up the antidote, but we're taking it!
say:19:1223517014:1.source_cn: 没错啊，你不要解药，我们要！

say:20:1223517015:1.text: Alright... Guys, let's surrender to stay alive.
say:20:1223517015:1.source_cn: 好吧……兄弟们，为了保命放弃抵抗，跟我去血薇帮认罪吧。

say:26:1223517016:0.text: Knox, you can take them back. They're all begging to go with you!
say:26:1223517016:0.source_cn: 诺克，你把他们带回去吧，他们现在求都要求着跟你回血薇帮呢！

say:27:1223517017:1.text: Got it. Thanks for your hard work!

narration:28:1223517018:0.text: Renata and the rest are escorted back to the Carmine Whispers' place...
narration:28:1223517018:0.source_cn: 雷纳塔等人被押回了血薇帮……

choice:11:0:1.text: Wait for death to come then.
choice:11:0:1.male: Wait for death to come then.
choice:11:0:1.female: Wait for death to come then.

say:30:1223517007:0.text: W-why don't you answer me? Are you going to turn a blind eye to my suffering?!
say:30:1223517007:0.source_cn: 你……你这是什么意思，你要见死不救吗？！
say:30:1223517007:0.male: W-why don't you answer me? Are you going to turn a blind eye to my suffering?!
say:30:1223517007:0.female: W-why don't you answer me? Are you going to turn a blind eye to my suffering?!

say:1:1223518002:0.text: Let's check on Al, Magister. He's the man in the spotlight now!
say:1:1223518002:0.source_cn: 过去看看阿尔吧，主人，这下他可成名人了吧！
say:1:1223518002:0.male: Let's check on Al, Magister. He's the man in the spotlight now!
say:1:1223518002:0.female: Let's check on Al, Magister. He's the man in the spotlight now!

say:2:1223519002:0.text: What do you think of our new stall?
say:2:1223519002:0.source_cn: 看看咱们的新摊位咋样？
say:2:1223519002:0.male: What do you think of our new stall?
say:2:1223519002:0.female: What do you think of our new stall?

choice_prompt:3:1223519002.text: What do you think of our new stall?
choice_prompt:3:1223519002.source_cn: 看看咱们的新摊位咋样？
choice_prompt:3:1223519002.male: What do you think of our new stall?
choice_prompt:3:1223519002.female: What do you think of our new stall?

say:4:1223519003:0.text: Ha! It's the courtesy of the Carmine Whispers. They said it was the reward for capturing Renata.
say:4:1223519003:0.source_cn: 哈！这都是血薇帮帮弄的，说是抓到雷纳塔的奖励。
say:4:1223519003:0.male: Ha! It's the courtesy of the Carmine Whispers. They said it was the reward for capturing Renata.
say:4:1223519003:0.female: Ha! It's the courtesy of the Carmine Whispers. They said it was the reward for capturing Renata.

say:5:1223519006:1.text: With more customers coming in, we've been thinking about ways to sell more fish—in other words, to boost our competitiveness!
say:5:1223519006:1.source_cn: 鱼铺顾客多了之后，我们也思考了怎么卖更多鱼，也就是俗话...
say:5:1223519006:1.male: With more customers coming in, we've been thinking about ways to sell more fish—in other words, to boost our competitiveness!
say:5:1223519006:1.female: With more customers coming in, we've been thinking about ways to sell more fish—in other words, to boost our competitiveness!

say:7:1223519007:0.text: Competitiveness? You sound like a pro already!
say:7:1223519007:0.source_cn: 竞争力，这词还挺专业的。

say:8:1223519008:1.text: I picked up the term from the Carmine Whispers. They really know their stuff, and I've learned a lot from them!
say:8:1223519008:1.source_cn: 是啊，都是血薇帮的人教的，嘿！他们懂得还挺多！教了我们不少！

say:9:1223519009:1.text: How are you planning to achieve that?
say:9:1223519009:1.source_cn: 那你们要怎么提升竞争力呢？

say:10:1223519010:1.text: The answer is... damedanglers! I bet you didn't see that coming! Only we Water Wights can catch the fish!
say:10:1223519010:1.source_cn: 答案就是……冥湾美人！哈哈，没想到吧！这种鱼只有我们水...

choice_prompt:11:1223519010.text: The answer is... damedanglers! I bet you didn't see that coming! Only we Water Wights can catch the fish!
choice_prompt:11:1223519010.source_cn: 答案就是……冥湾美人！哈哈，没想到吧！这种鱼只有我们水鬼帮能钓得到！

say:12:1223519011:1.text: I almost forgot that <style="stress"><player_name></style> can also catch it! It's a good thing that you don't run a fish stall too, hahaha!
say:12:1223519011:1.male: I almost forgot that <style="stress"><player_name></style> can also catch it! It's a good thing that you don't run a fish stall too, hahaha!
say:12:1223519011:1.female: I almost forgot that <style="stress"><player_name></style> can also catch it! It's a good thing that you don't run a fish stall too, hahaha!

say:15:1223519012:1.text: I heard you have damedanglers here. Are they fresh? I don't want any frozen ones.
say:15:1223519012:1.source_cn: 听说你们这里有冥湾美人，是现钓的吗？冻成冰坨的我可不吃。

say:16:1223519013:1.text: I guarantee they're all freshly caught! If you're still not convinced, I can let my guy catch one for you right now, but it'll be a bit pricier.
say:16:1223519013:1.source_cn: 大哥您就放心吃，绝对现钓上来的！您要是不放心，我让伙计...

say:17:1223519014:1.text: I'll take this one then. Here's the money.

say:18:1223519015:1.text: Please come again, mate! We have other fish here too!
say:18:1223519015:1.source_cn: 再来啊，大哥！下回可以看看其他的鱼！

say:21:1223519016:1.text: Looks like your business is thriving!

say:22:1223519017:1.text: I... *Cough*... We Water Wights never imagined we could be selling fish at the port one day.
say:22:1223519017:1.source_cn: 我……咳咳……我们这群水鬼，做梦都没想过能以鱼贩的身份...

say:24:1223519019:1.text: Words aren't enough to express our gratitude, so we've all prepared some gifts for you. We'll always remember your support!
say:24:1223519019:1.source_cn: 有句话叫大恩不言谢，手头这些谢礼都是兄弟们的意思，来日...
